# 2 Baruch Chapter 2 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Fall of Jerusalem

---

**2:1** "For I-will-not-forget all the-chastisement of-my-people, but-only for-a-season shall it-be-forgotten.

**2:2** And I-will-remember them in-the-end-of-days and-will-restore them, because the-name of-Israel shall-not-be-forgotten forever.

**2:3** And thereafter the-adversaries shall-fall and-the-enemies-of-Israel shall-be-destroyed; and-Israel shall-be-exalted.

**2:4** And those who-have-been-cast-down shall-be-lifted-up, and those who-have-been-lifted-up shall-be-cast-down.

**2:5** And I-shall-punish those who-have-oppressed them, and-I-will-chasten those who-have-trodden-them-underfoot; and-I-will-comfort those who-have-mourned on-account-of-Zion.

**2:6** For Israel is-not-given over to-destruction, and those who-have-become-scattered-among-the-nations are-not-forgotten in-the-sight-of-the-LORD.

**2:7** For the-LORD created the-world for-the-sake-of-Israel; and not-because-he-loved a-people has-he-done-all-this, but-because-he-prepared [it] from-the-beginning for-the-sake-of-his-people."

---

*EMET notes: Hyphenated compounds preserve Syriac construct chains. Ch. 2 is God's continuing response assuring Baruch of future restoration. "End of days" is a messianic temporal marker.*
